proposals.evidence: Turner 11640 explicitly lists European Romani bikin- ‘sell’ and Middle Indo-Aryan vikkiṇāti. The source gives biken- as the present stem and biken-d- as its perfect stem on p.138 §3.6.2; -d is the source's productive perfect marker, not a separate historical root. Source image, glyph-decoded audit and reviewed import row checked; no transcription or identity changes.

proposals.evidence: Turner 10074 gives European and Armenian Romani mang- ‘ask for’, and Palestinian Romani mángăr ‘wants’. The addendum questions the Sanskritized headword mā́rgati in favour of older mr̥gyáti; keep that uncertainty inside the CDIAL family. The source prints māng-/māng-l- as present/perfect stems on p.138 §3.6.2, with productive -l. Source image, glyph-decoded audit and reviewed import row checked; no transcription or identity changes.
